# Fate UI v0.8.10-beta7

Fate UI now starts with all folders collapsed, and compact session rows look identical whether a folder is active or not.

## Sidebar changes

- **Fate UI starts with all folders collapsed.** Folders no longer auto-expand when they become active; expand the one you want. Your manual expand/collapse choices are still remembered across restarts.
- **Unified compact session design.** In compact mode, the active folder now uses the same clean preview-style rows as inactive folders (title + message count + relative time + attention dot), with a hover-only actions menu and drag reordering. A folder no longer visibly changes design when it gains or loses focus. Conversation paths still render beneath the active session's row.

## Compatibility and installers

No migration is needed. Existing projects, Pi sessions, settings, themes, and folder history are unchanged.

GitHub Actions builds and tests this release on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64. The prerelease contains installers plus `SHA256SUMS`:

- Windows x64: NSIS `.exe`
- macOS arm64 and x64: `.dmg` and `.pkg`
- Linux x64: `.AppImage` and `.deb`

Public beta installers remain unsigned. Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may show an unknown-publisher warning. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.
